verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API, a Postman collection, an OpenAPI schema, webhooks and an llms.txt index, but none of it mentions an official command-line tool for ComplyAdvantage Mesh. These are developer building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit toward a CLI story. An official CLI is a plausible offering for a SaaS API platform, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
